tokens.name: forest
tokens.usage: Main dark ground for Statement posts, the logo badge and bottom bars. The colour people know us by.

tokens.name: forest-stripe-a
tokens.usage: Light band of the mow-stripe pattern on forest grounds. Bands 90px wide at 1080px.

tokens.name: forest-stripe-b
tokens.usage: Dark band of the mow-stripe pattern, alternating with forest-stripe-a.

tokens.name: leaf
tokens.usage: Accent: kickers, the second line of a Statement headline, the Tip post ground. Never body text on paper or white.

tokens.name: leaf-ink
tokens.usage: All text on leaf grounds (about 8:1).

tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Light ground for Classic print posts. Slightly green so it never reads as generic cream.

tokens.name: white
tokens.usage: Ground for Review posts; headline and phone number on forest.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Headlines and body on paper and white (over 15:1).

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text on paper and white: reviewer line, captions (about 7:1).

tokens.name: sage
tokens.usage: Body copy on forest (about 11:1).

tokens.name: star
tokens.usage: Review stars only. Decorative, always next to the written rating.

tokens.name: rule-on-forest
tokens.usage: Hairline above the footer on forest grounds.

tokens.name: rule-on-light
tokens.usage: Hairline above the footer on paper and white.

styles.name: statement-xl
styles.usage: Statement post headline, 2 to 4 words a line, uppercase, max 3 lines.

styles.name: numeral
styles.usage: Tip number or a single big figure. Only when it counts something real.

styles.name: wordmark
styles.usage: Wordmark next to the badge until the real logo file is supplied.

styles.name: print-headline
styles.usage: Classic print headline, sentence case, 2 lines.

styles.name: quote
styles.sample: Friendly crew, showed up when they said.

styles.name: body-l
styles.sample: Driveway and walks cleared all winter.
styles.usage: Supporting line on Statement posts, max 20 words.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Same crew, same day, every week.
styles.usage: Body on Print and Tip posts, max 40 words.

styles.name: cta
styles.usage: Footer call to action on light grounds.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Small labels under the wordmark and above figures.

tokens.name: safe-statement
tokens.usage: Outer margin on Statement and Tip posts at 1080px.

tokens.name: safe-print
tokens.usage: Outer margin on Print and Review posts: more air for the quiet layouts.

tokens.name: gap-l
tokens.usage: Headline to body.

tokens.name: gap-m
tokens.usage: Footer rule to footer content.

tokens.name: gap-s
tokens.usage: Kicker to headline.

tokens.name: stripe
tokens.usage: Width of one mow stripe band.

tokens.name: radius-none
tokens.usage: Everything. The brand is square cut.

tokens.name: radius-photo
tokens.usage: Only on small inset photos or swatches on Print posts.

tokens.name: radius-badge
tokens.usage: The round logo badge.
